author: edwong57
body:
Claude assisted identification -

There are 12 PTN nodes in 11 families, which together carry all **638 IBA annotations** to **GO:0070585 protein localization to mitochondrion** (GOlr, 2026-10-23).

| PTHR family | PTN node | IBAs | Supporting experimental annotation(s) (`with`) | Suggested new term |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| PTHR11851 metalloprotease (MPP) | PTN000220240 | 149 | SGD:S000004153 (MAS1), RGD:621297 (Pmpcb), CGD:CAL0000195289, UniProtKB:Q38F91 | GO:0034982 mitochondrial protein processing (**see note 2**) |
| PTHR11851 metalloprotease (MPP) | PTN002274973 | 54 | SGD:S000001066 (MAS2), CGD:CAL0000178676, dictyBase:DDB_G0274809 (mppA1) | GO:0034982 mitochondrial protein processing |
| PTHR12383 protease family S26 (IMP1) | PTN000272699 | 112 | SGD:S000004758 (IMP1) | GO:0034982 mitochondrial protein processing |
| PTHR46041 IMP subunit 2 | PTN000962786 | 86 | SGD:S000004638 (IMP2), MGI:MGI:2135611 (Immp2l) | GO:0034982 mitochondrial protein processing |
| PTHR32409 TOM20-1-related (plant TOM20) | PTN001285887 | 69 | AGI:AT1G27390, AT3G27080, AT5G40930 (TOM20-2/-3/-4) | GO:7770058 mitochondrial protein import pathway |
| PTHR45778 purple acid phosphatase-related | PTN002909053 | 64 | AGI:AT1G13900 (PAP2) | GO:7770058 mitochondrial protein import pathway |
| PTHR45984 RNA pol II-associated protein homolog (TOMM34) | PTN002505448 | 34 | UniProtKB:Q15785 (TOMM34) | GO:7770058 mitochondrial protein import pathway |
| PTHR16501 Tango11 (MFF) | PTN000420890 | 26 | UniProtKB:Q9GZY8 (MFF), MGI:MGI:1922984 (Mff) | GO:0090141 positive regulation of mitochondrial fission |
| PTHR43888 DnaJ-like-2 (DNAJA1) | PTN008686281 | 18 | UniProtKB:P31689 (DNAJA1) | **review**, see note 3 |
| PTHR22791 RING-type (RNF186) | PTN000419843 | 11 | UniProtKB:Q9NXI6 (RNF186) | **review**, see note 3 |
| PTHR38402 OM14 | PTN002212597 | 8 | SGD:S000000434 (OM14) | GO:7770058 mitochondrial protein import pathway |
| PTHR28188 TOM5 | PTN002407827 | 7 | SGD:S000006433 (TOM5) | GO:7770058 mitochondrial protein import pathway |
| | **Total** | **638** | | |

(27 of the IBAs have no `panther_family` value in GOlr. They are mostly Arabidopsis, and their PTN nodes are included in the counts above.)

* **Sequences with problematic annotation (ID + gene/protein name):**

All propagated descendants of the PTN nodes above. Examples:
- MPP/IMP families: PMPCA, PMPCB, IMMP1L, IMMP2L (human); MAS1, MAS2, IMP1, IMP2 (yeast); MPPbeta, IMP1A, IMP1B (Arabidopsis)
- Import families: TOM20-1 to TOM20-4, PAP2, PAP9 (Arabidopsis); TOMM34 (human/mouse); OM14, TOM5 (yeast)
- Others: MFF, DNAJA1, RNF186 (human/mouse)

Full list: GOlr query, `annotation_class:"GO:0070585"` and `evidence_type:IBA`.

* **Type of Issue: Erroneous source or erroneous propagation, or other issue**

Other: the term is being obsoleted.
- GO:0070585 is proposed for obsoletion in https://github.com/geneontology/go-ontology/issues/32674, with **no replaced_by**. Any IBAs still on it when it is obsoleted will be lost rather than repaired.
- The experimental annotations behind these nodes are being reviewed and moved in [LINK TO go-annotation REVIEW TICKET].

Notes:
1. **Peptidase nodes (4 nodes, 401 IBAs).** These are the largest share. Much of the source annotation reached GO:0070585 through the obsolete GO:0006627 *protein processing involved in protein targeting to mitochondrion*. Its `replaced_by` points to GO:0070585, but go-ontology#30349 asked for GO:0034982 mitochondrial protein processing. GO:0034982 is the natural home for MPP and IMP.
2. **PTN000220240** propagates to the bc1 complex core subunits **UQCRC1** (human/mouse) and **COR1** (yeast) as well as PMPCB. Please check that the processing annotation should reach these: mammalian and yeast core 1 are generally not considered active peptidases. This may be worth a NOT at that node, or moving the annotation to a lower node.
3. **DNAJA1 and RNF186** are supported only by DNAJA1 IMP (PMID:14752510, about Bax translocation in apoptosis) and RNF186 IMP (PMID:23896122, about ER-stress apoptosis via BNip1). In the annotation review, both source annotations are marked REVIEW rather than MOVE. Please hold or remove these nodes until the source annotations are resolved; they don't look like mitochondrial protein import.
4. **The move to GO:7770058 depends on an ontology change.** GO:7770058 currently has no protein-transport ancestor; go-ontology#32674 proposes `is_a GO:0006886 intracellular protein transport`. Until that is in, IBAs moved to GO:7770058 won't roll up to protein transport.

The suggested targets are based on the supporting experimental annotations and paper titles, not on a full re-examination of the trees.

Related:
- go-ontology#32674 (obsolete GO:0070585)
- go-ontology#32673 (obsolete GO:0072656)
- go-ontology#30349
- go-annotation review ticket: https://github.com/geneontology/go-annotation/issues/6635
